EnableAutoEngaged.Name: Enable automatic Engaged handling
EnableAutoEngaged.Hint: Enables or disables all automatic handling of the Engaged battle status.

RequireActiveCombat.Name: Apply Engaged only during active combat
RequireActiveCombat.Hint: When enabled, the Engaged status is applied only after combat has started (round 1+). This setting is ignored if automatic Engaged handling is disabled.

CombatantRequirement.Name: Engagement eligibility
CombatantRequirement.Hint: Defines whether both actors, only one, or none must be active combatants for Engaged to be applied. This setting applies only when automatic Engaged handling is enabled.

Choices.Either: At least one actor must be a combatant

EngagementTooltipVisibility.Name: Engagement tooltip visibility
EngagementTooltipVisibility.Hint: Defines who can see engagement badge tooltips on tokens.

enableConditionPenaltyFix.Name: Condition Penalty Fix
enableConditionPenaltyFix.Hint: Keeps only the worst active negative condition penalty in roll dialogs.

conditionPenaltyFixDebug.Name: Condition Penalty Fix Debug
conditionPenaltyFixDebug.Hint: Enable debug logs for the condition penalty fix.

ShowEngagementLines.Name: Show engagement lines
ShowEngagementLines.Hint: Draws lines between tokens that are currently engaged.

EngagementLineWidth.Name: Engagement line width
EngagementLineWidth.Hint: Sets the thickness of engagement lines.

EngagementLineColor.Name: Engagement line color
EngagementLineColor.Hint: Sets the color of engagement lines using a hex value.

EngagementLineAlpha.Name: Engagement line opacity
EngagementLineAlpha.Hint: Sets the opacity of engagement lines.

EngagementLineStyle.Name: Engagement line style
EngagementLineStyle.Hint: Sets the visual style of engagement lines.

Chat.EngagedRemovedNoLongerEngaged: {token} is no longer engaged (no melee last round {round}).
